question: A cube of edge length 4 units is removed from one corner of a cube of edge length 10 units.  What is the surface area of the resulting figure?
What is the closest integer to 12.2 x 7.8?
What value of x satisfies the equation $x + x/(2x + 4x) = 2$?  Express your answer as a fraction.

Callie has 3 days to see 6 distinct movies.  How many ways can Callie arrange her schedule over 3 days so that she sees 2 different movies each day, if the order of movies on any given day does not matter?
A triangle has vertices A(-1,2), B(5,8), and C(-1,-7).  Point D(x,y) is on side BC, and the area of triangle ACD is half the area of triangle ABC.  What is the value of x + y?
A pair of 6-sided dice are rolled.  What is the probability that the product of the numbers shown is a multiple of 3?  Express your answer as a common fraction.
In the figure shown, what is the value on n?
A fair coin is flipped 10 times.  What is the probability that neither heads nor tails shows up twice in a row?  Express your answer as a common fraction.

The odds that Callie will come in first in a race is 5 to 12.  This represents the ratio of the probability that she will come in first to the probability that she will not come in first.  What is the probability that someone else will come in first in the race?  Express your answer as a fraction.
What is the sum of all solutions w to the equation $|4 - 5w| = 2$?  Express your answer as a common fraction.
How many ordered triples (a, b, c) of non-negative integers exist for which a + b + c = 4?
If $(\sqrt{2})^n = \sqrt[16]{16}$, what is the value of n?  Express your answer as a common fraction.

Callie has a box of chess pieces, 16 black and 16 white.  She selects 3 pieces at random, without replacement.  What is the probability that all 3 chess pieces are the same color?  Express your answer as a common fraction.
The graph of the line y = 6x - 5 intersects the graph of the parabola $y=x^2$ at 2 points (x,y).  What is the distance between those 2 points?  Express your answer in simplest radical form.
Circles P and Q are tangent to each other and have radii 18 units and 32 units respectively.  Circles P and Q are also tangential to a line segment at points X and Y. What is XY?
If line l intersects parallel lines m and n, what is the value of p + q?
In a geometric sequence of positive numbers, if the 1015th term is 245 and the 3015th term is 45, what is the value of the 2015th term?

You have a map of 6 square blocks.  Mae's house is at the lower left corner M(0,0).  The library is at L(2,2) and the garden is at G(3,0).  How many different ways can Mae walk from M to L, and then to G?  Assume she doesn't walk more than 7 blocks.
How many different values of x satisfy the equation $|x^2-9| = |2x + 6|$?

An ant walks around a rectangle from point A to B to C to D, a distance of 28.25 units.  A ladybug walks from point B to C to D to A, a distance of 25 units.  What is the perimeter of the rectangle?  Express as a common fraction.
A fair coin is flipped 8 times.  What is the probability that it lands heads up exactly 4 times.  Express your answer as a common fraction.

Callie wants to buy a dozen donuts.  There are 3 flavors (jelly, chocolate, vanilla).  If Callie wants at least 2 jelly donuts, how many different combinations of donuts can she use to create a box of a dozen donuts?
A rectangle is inscribed in a circle.  If one side of the rectangle is 6 and the area of the circle is $25\pi$, what is the area of the rectangle?
